name: Signal
best_for: Quiet editorial narratives with concise evidence
avoid_for: Contexts that should feel hot, fast, or intentionally playful — the navy + gold restraint commits to a sober voice
weak_cases: Edge-to-edge detail conflicts with breathing space; low-opacity chrome needs real legibility checks.
visual_signature: Navy/cream dual surfaces, serif roman/italic contrast, precise gold and hairlines.

provenance.adaptation: Recipe retained and curated for Deck Studio; selector describes source-supported structures, not rendered acceptance.

language_posture: Roman/italic distinction needs a script-appropriate emphasis role; mixed-script line metrics need inspection.

assets.images: No image required; type, shapes and surface treatments can carry the system.
